message:
The whiteboard holds the whole job in six steps with their hand-overs. Sunlight becomes dispatchable electricity which removes field heat from the chamber that encloses and holds the produce under regulation, so no gap is left between functions. The load that sizes everything is about 1 tonne of fresh produce, meaning 1000 kg.

Every member first brings the best existing off-grid cold stores from their field with source as concepts, Solar Energy Systems Engineer for power, Cold-Chain Refrigeration Engineer for cooling, Enclosure and Structural Designer for the box, Smallholder Cooperative Operations Specialist for use. Then every member posts at least one concept for every function or states in one line that their field has none, and names any missing function.

For numbers and behaviour over time, Solar Energy Systems Engineer will compute the Photovoltaic (PV) energy balance by calc and night autonomy by simulate, Cold-Chain Refrigeration Engineer will compute steady heat load by calc and pull-down and holding temperature by simulate, Enclosure and Structural Designer will compute chamber volume for 1000 kg and insulation by calc. My position is not ready, because functions are set but no concepts or evidence are yet on the board.
Note on Solar Energy Systems Engineer: no observation yet.
